displayName.zh-CN: 更好的 deepseek harness（codex 风格）

description.zh-CN: 面向 Coding 用户的 DSH 整合包：Codex 风格工作区侧栏与轮次导航、/review 独立子 Agent 代码审查、/simplify Git 范围代码简化、只读旁问、Codex 式思考强度连续滑块、费用与余额计量、DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠、AST 上下文压缩与 token 预算守卫、Git 分支图、多智能体协作（agent-teams）、上下文可视化仪表盘（dsh-context）、子代理独立选模型（subagent-director）、多智能体议事厅（agent-arena）、思考循环守护（loop-guard）、跨会话长期记忆（mneme）、视觉桥与截图理解（modlens）、回答内嵌矢量图（inline-figures）、Prompt 模板工具箱（dsh-prompt）、Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸、API 额度上限显示（key-limits）、Windows Computer Use 桌面操控（22 个工具，含安全护栏）、Codex 风格 Computer Use（dsh-computer-use，13 个 window2 原生工具 + 可见合成光标覆盖层 + Esc 急停，挂在独立 computer-use preset）、QQ 机器人频道（dsh-qqbot，默认关闭、按需启用）、WorkBuddy 桌面端模型接入（dsh-workbuddy-connect，复用 WorkBuddy App 登录态，零配置在 DSH 模型选择器里选用 GLM-5.3、DeepSeek-V4、Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3、Hy3 等，国内版与国际版分组并存；未登录时该分组自动隐藏，不影响启动）。基座 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，全部插件已钉死精确版本并校验 peer 兼容。v2.5.0 起整合包额外自带 49 个跨 harness 精选 skill（安装时由 home/skills/ 落入 DSH_HOME/skills/）。v2.7.1 修复 6 个自带 skill 误嵌套的 home/ 目录（安装后成为 skill 加载器扫不到的死数据），并给构建脚本加打包期防回归校验；dsh-computer-use 增加平台守卫，非 Windows 平台该 sidecar 安静禁用、不再打印启动 Traceback。
description.en-US: A coding-oriented DSH modpack: Codex-style workspace sidebar and turn navigation, /review independent code review, /simplify Git-scoped simplification, read-only side-ask, Codex-style reasoning-effort slider, cost and balance metering, a DeepSeek whale-girl desk pet, AST context compression with token budget guard, a Git graph, multi-agent teams (agent-teams), a context visualization dashboard (dsh-context), per-subagent model director (subagent-director), a multi-agent council (agent-arena), thought-loop guard (loop-guard), cross-session memory (mneme), vision bridge & screenshot understanding (modlens), inline vector figures (inline-figures), a prompt template toolbox (dsh-prompt), Wallpaper Engine live wallpapers, API key quota limits (key-limits), and Windows Computer Use desktop control (22 tools with safety guards), Codex-style Computer Use (dsh-computer-use: 13 native window2 tools, a visible synthetic-cursor overlay and an Esc interrupt, mounted in its own computer-use preset), plus a QQ Bot IM channel (dsh-qqbot, official Tencent plugin), and WorkBuddy desktop model access (dsh-workbuddy-connect: reuses the WorkBuddy app sign-in so GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, Hy3 and more appear in the DSH model picker with zero configuration, with separate groups for the domestic and international editions; when no sign-in is present the group simply hides and startup is unaffected). Built for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; all plugins pinned to exact versions and peer-verified. As of v2.5.0 the pack also bundles 49 curated cross-harness skills (shipped via home/skills/, landing in DSH_HOME/skills/ on install). v2.7.1 fixes 6 bundled skills that carried a mistakenly nested home/ directory (which became dead data unreadable by the skill loader after install), adds a pack-time regression guard to the build script, and introduces a platform guard for dsh-computer-use so its sidecar is quietly disabled on non-Windows instead of printing a startup Traceback.
